title: Security Engineering

seo.title: Security Engineering | Julie Zimmerman
seo.description: Security engineering for malware response, integrity verification, hardening, recovery, and recurrence prevention.

hero.headline: Finding the compromise, removing it, and fixing the conditions that allowed it.
intro: My security work grows out of operating long-lived production systems: malware investigation, WordPress compromise cleanup, integrity verification, hardening, and policies that reduce preventable exposure across a large fleet.

I approach incidents as system failures rather than isolated bad files. Recovery includes identifying persistence, restoring trust, preserving business function, and reducing the chance of recurrence.

philosophy.title: Engineering Philosophy
philosophy.anchor: Security is not a cleanup step. It is a property of how the system is designed and operated.
philosophy.intro: Treat every unexplained change as evidence, not noise.
principles: Remove persistence mechanisms, not only visible payloads.
Reduce attack surface through updates, retirement, least privilege, and operational standards.
philosophy.closing: Reduce attack surface through updates, retirement, least privilege, and operational standards.

problems.title: Problems I Solve
problems.intro: The most valuable work usually begins where a system has accumulated complexity, operational risk, or assumptions no one has revisited.
items: Unknown web shells and altered core files
Secure recovery without unnecessary destruction of content or functionality

approach.title: How I Work
paragraphs: I establish a trustworthy baseline, trace indicators across files, database content, users, scheduled tasks, and configuration, then remove both payload and persistence.
After recovery, I verify from multiple angles and address the operational conditions that made the compromise durable.

experience.summary: Lead developer and systems architect for a large, long-lived portfolio of production websites and integrations.
evidence: Technical standards, migration planning, launch QA, and incident response

experience.summary: Technical lead in enterprise higher-education software, working across large Oracle systems, performance testing, defect analysis, and release delivery.
evidence: Synthetic data generation exceeding one million records

related_writing.title: Related Writing
related_writing.intro: Case studies and essays that show the underlying engineering decisions.

business_value.title: Why recovery must extend beyond cleanup
paragraphs: Deleting the obvious malicious file may restore a page while leaving the attacker’s access intact.
Durable recovery restores confidence in the whole system and changes the conditions that allowed the incident to persist.

contact.title: Let's Talk
paragraphs: For technical leadership, architecture, modernization, or complex systems work, contact me directly.

closing_statement: A system is not clean because the warning disappeared. It is clean when trust has been rebuilt.
